environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. user-service runs in 'backend' namespace with strict mTLS (PeerAuthentication STRICT). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the user-service workload with the following spec: action DENY for source principals not matching 'cluster.local/ns/backend/sa/*' when the request path has prefix '/internal/'. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with action ALLOW exists that permits traffic to '/api/*' from any authenticated source within the mesh. The DENY policy takes precedence per Istio's policy evaluation order (DENY before ALLOW). The Envoy sidecar is injected via namespace label istio-injection=enabled and runs in strict interception mode (istio-init iptables rules redirect all inbound traffic through the proxy on port 15006).
